“冷欣，求你，求你救救九郎，求你用你的蛊毒，以命换命，救救他！只要能救九郎，我愿意付出任何代价，哪怕是我的性命，我也心甘情愿！”

冷欣看着跪在地上的杨童，心中满是动容与为难。以命换命的蛊术，乃是禁术，一旦施展，施术者将会付出生命的代价，而被救者也只能暂时保住性命，后续还要承受巨大的痛苦，甚至可能留下终身的后遗症。

而且这种蛊术成功率极低，稍有不慎，不仅救不了胡九郎，杨童也会白白牺牲。

“杨童，你别冲动，以命换命太过危险，而且是禁术，我不能这么做！我再想想别的办法，一定能救九郎的，一定能！”

冷欣连忙上前，想要扶起杨童。

“没有别的办法了，冷欣，我知道，只有以命换命，才能救九郎！”

杨童一边说，一边不停地磕头，额头很快就磕出了鲜血，染红了祭坛的黑色岩石。

她的眼神坚定而执着，没有丝毫退缩，仿佛只要冷欣不答应，她就会一直磕下去，直到磕死为止。

胡九郎躺在杨童的怀里，意识虽然模糊，却能清晰地听到杨童的话，能感受到她的绝望与恳求。

他想开口，想阻止杨童，想告诉她，他宁愿死，也不愿意让她为自己付出生命的代价，可他浑身无力，连张开嘴巴的力气都没有，只能发出微弱的呜咽声。

冷欣看着杨童的模样，看着胡九郎眼中的不舍与愧疚，心中的防线彻底崩塌，深吸一口气，缓缓点了点头。

“好，我答应你。但你要想清楚，一旦施展禁术，你就会失去生命，再也回不来了，你真的愿意吗？”

杨童听到冷欣的话，眼中瞬间燃起一丝希望，抬起头，脸上满是泪水和血迹，却露出了一抹欣慰的笑容。

“我愿意，只要能救九郎，我什么都愿意！冷欣，谢谢你，谢谢你！”

冷欣点了点头，深吸一口气，缓缓站起身，紧紧攥着手中的本命蛊鼎，眼神变得坚定起来。

冷欣走到胡九郎和杨童的身边，让杨童将胡九郎放平，双手快速结印，口中念起晦涩的蛊咒，本命蛊鼎渐渐悬浮起来，鼎身的蛊纹闪烁着淡淡的绿光，一股浓郁的蛊气从鼎中涌出，包裹着胡九郎和杨童的身体。

冷欣的脸色渐渐变得苍白，额头上渗出细密的汗珠，将鼎中的蛊毒与自己的真炁融合在一起，小心翼翼地注入杨童的体内，再通过杨童的身体，将那股蕴含着生机的力量，传递到胡九郎的体内，驱散他体内的阴邪雾气，修复他受损的经脉。

杨童感觉到一股温热的力量，从自己的体内涌出，传递到胡九郎的体内，同时她也感觉到自己的生命力，在飞速流逝，体内的真炁在一点点消散，浑身变得越来越无力，意识也开始变得模糊。

杨童伸出颤抖的手，轻轻抚摸着胡九郎的脸颊，眼神中满是眷恋与不舍。

杨童的手缓缓垂了下去，眼神彻底黯淡下去，气息也彻底消散，她的脸上还带着一抹温柔的笑容，仿佛只是睡着了一般，可再也不会醒来。

冷欣施展完禁术，浑身一软，倒在地上，喷出一口鲜血，气息微弱。

她看着杨童的尸体，看着胡九郎绝望的模样，心中满是愧疚与无奈。

她虽然救了胡九郎，却牺牲了杨童的性命，这份愧疚，将会伴随她一生。

胡九郎气息也平稳了一些，但他的意识却格外清晰。他知道杨童为了救他，付出了自己的生命。

胡九郎的意识突然变得模糊起来，眼前的景象，渐渐消失，取而代之的，是一片朦胧的白光。

"Leng Xin, please, please save Jiulang, please use your poison to exchange life for life, save him! As long as I can save Jiulang, I am willing to pay any price, even my life, I am willing!"

Leng Xin looked at Yang Tong kneeling on the ground, her heart filled with emotion and embarrassment.The Gu technique of exchanging one's life for one's life is a forbidden technique. Once it is performed, the user will pay the price with his life, and the rescued person can only temporarily save his life, but will suffer tremendous pain in the future, and may even leave lifelong sequelae.

Moreover, the success rate of this kind of voodoo technique is extremely low. If you are not careful, not only will you not be able to save Hu Jiulang, but Yang Tong will also die in vain.

"Yang Tong, don't be impulsive. It's too dangerous to exchange one's life for one's life, and it's a forbidden technique. I can't do that! I'll think of other ways and I'll definitely be able to save Jiulang. I definitely can!"

Leng Xin quickly stepped forward to help Yang Tong up.

"There is no other way, Leng Xin, I know that only by exchanging life for life can we save Jiulang!"

As Yang Tong spoke, he kept kowtowing. Blood soon came out of his forehead, staining the black rock of the altar red.

Her eyes were firm and persistent, without flinching at all, as if as long as Leng Xin didn't agree, she would keep knocking until she died.

Hu Jiulang lay in Yang Tong's arms. Although his consciousness was blurred, he could clearly hear Yang Tong's words and feel her despair and pleading.

He wanted to speak, wanted to stop Yang Tong, wanted to tell her that he would rather die than let her pay the price with her life, but he was so weak that he didn't even have the strength to open his mouth and could only make a weak whimper.

Leng Xin looked at Yang Tong's appearance and the reluctance and guilt in Hu Jiulang's eyes. The defense in her heart completely collapsed. She took a deep breath and nodded slowly.

"Okay, I promise you. But you have to think clearly, once you use the forbidden technique, you will lose your life and you will never get it back. Are you really willing?"

When Yang Tong heard Leng Xin's words, a glimmer of hope instantly ignited in his eyes. He raised his head, his face was full of tears and blood, but he showed a happy smile.

"I am willing, as long as I can save Jiulang, I am willing to do anything! Leng Xin, thank you, thank you!"

Leng Xin nodded, took a deep breath, stood up slowly, tightly grasped the Gu Cauldron in his hand, and his eyes became firm.

Leng Xin walked up to Hu Jiulang and Yang Tong and asked Yang Tong to lay Hu Jiulang down. She quickly formed seals with her hands and chanted an obscure Gu mantra in her mouth. The natal Gu cauldron gradually floated into suspension. The Gu patterns on the cauldron's body flashed with a faint green light. A strong Gu Qi surged out from the cauldron and enveloped the bodies of Hu Jiulang and Yang Tong.

Leng Xin's face gradually turned pale, and fine beads of sweat oozed from his forehead. He fused the poison in the cauldron with his own true energy, carefully injected it into Yang Tong's body, and then passed the vitality-containing power through Yang Tong's body to Hu Jiulang's body, dispelling the evil mist in his body and repairing his damaged meridians.

Yang Tong felt a warm force pouring out of her body and passed into Hu Jiulang's body. At the same time, she also felt that her life force was passing away rapidly. The true energy in her body was dissipating little by little. Her whole body became weaker and weaker, and her consciousness began to become blurred.

Yang Tong stretched out his trembling hand and gently stroked Hu Jiulang's cheek, his eyes full of nostalgia and reluctance.

Yang Tong's hand slowly dropped, her eyes dimmed completely, and her breath completely dissipated. There was still a gentle smile on her face, as if she had just fallen asleep and would never wake up again.

After Leng Xin performed the forbidden technique, her whole body went limp and she fell to the ground, spitting out a mouthful of blood with weak breath.

She looked at Yang Tong's body and Hu Jiulang's desperate look, her heart filled with guilt and helplessness.

Although she saved Hu Jiulang, she sacrificed Yang Tong's life. This guilt will stay with her for the rest of her life.

Hu Jiulang's breath became calmer, but his consciousness was extremely clear.He knew that Yang Tong sacrificed his life to save him.

Hu Jiulang's consciousness suddenly became blurred, and the scene in front of him gradually disappeared, replaced by a hazy white light.
